random.label: Random
random.description: Sample uniformly within the parameter bounds.

latin_hypercube.label: Latin hypercube
latin_hypercube.description: Sample a stratified ensemble covering every parameter range without adaptive updates.

num_points.label: Number of points
num_points.description: Total ensemble size; each parameter range is divided into this many equal strata.

resolve.label: Resolve
resolve.description: Evaluate an evenly spaced grid including both bounds.

spacing.label: Spacing
spacing.description: Maximum grid spacing in physical parameter units. Leave blank for half the smallest nonzero parameter range width.

simann.label: SimAnn
simann.description: Adapt bounded simulated-annealing chains using loss values.

stp_adjst_shift.label: Step adjustment shift
stp_adjst_shift.description: Shift used when adapting proposal steps.

stp_adjst_factor.label: Step adjustment factor
stp_adjst_factor.description: Factor used when adapting proposal steps.

chain_count.label: Chains
chain_count.description: Independent chains; blank derives count from workers and batch size.

adam.label: Adam (SPSA)
adam.description: Estimate gradients with paired loss probes and apply bounded Adam updates.

learning_rate.label: Learning rate
learning_rate.description: Step size in coordinates scaled to [0, 1].

perturbation.label: Perturbation
perturbation.description: SPSA probe distance in coordinates scaled to [0, 1].

spsa_pairs.label: SPSA pairs
spsa_pairs.description: Paired probes used for each gradient estimate.

adam_gradient.label: Adam (grad)
adam_gradient.description: Apply bounded Adam updates using derivatives of the complete tuning objective.

max_updates.label: Updates per chain
max_updates.description: Number of Adam updates; the final center is evaluated too.

learning_rate.label: Learning rate
learning_rate.description: Step size in coordinates scaled to [0, 1].

beta1.label: First moment decay
beta1.description: Exponential decay for the gradient mean.

beta2.label: Second moment decay
beta2.description: Exponential decay for the squared gradient mean.

epsilon.label: Epsilon
epsilon.description: Positive denominator stabilizer in normalized coordinates.
